conditions: We further control the difference between the KL-divergence of observed images and the KL-divergence of generated images at each training iteration using a fixed margin (Huang et al. 2018).

For example, we overcame a primary source of training instability which occurred when the KL-divergence of the generated images overwhelmed the KL-divergence of the observed images plus the reconstruction loss.

To avoid this problem in the best way, we scaled the KL-divergence loss terms within the range of 1/10 to 1/20 relative to the loss terms for reconstructing images, and annealed these terms from zero at the start of training to a maximum value after model convergence.
